We need to determine appropriate action. The customer says: "We were charged twice for this month's invoice on the same card — can you reverse the duplicate charge?" This is a request to reverse duplicate charge. According to policy excerpt DOC-051: "A charge a customer believes was made in error — including an apparent duplicate — is reviewed by the billing team rather than reversed automatically from the dashboard, because reversing a charge changes money that has already moved and needs to be verified against the account's actual billing record first, not just against how the invoice appears to the person reporting it."

Thus we can answer: we will have billing team review, cannot reverse automatically, they will investigate. Provide steps? The policy says it's reviewed by billing team. So answer: we will forward to billing team, they will investigate, may take some time. Provide that we cannot reverse automatically. So we can post a reply.

We must not mention policy. Keep short. Answer directly.

Thus we will post_reply.
